# Mikeu.Dev

> Personal portfolio and technical blog by Riki Ruswandi (Mikeu.Dev), a fullstack software engineer specializing in SvelteKit, geospatial (GIS) solutions, and scalable web applications. Based in Indonesia.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/): Landing page featuring project showcase, latest blog posts, and an interactive 3D world visitor map.
- [About](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/about): Professional background, interactive tech stack playground (physics-based), career journey timeline, and fun facts.
- [Blog](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/blog): Technical articles covering web development, AI/RAG, SvelteKit, GIS, and software engineering best practices.
- [Projects](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/projects): Curated portfolio of completed projects with live demos and source links.
- [World](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/world): Interactive Three.js globe visualizing real-time site visitors by geographic location.
- [Contact](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/contact): Professional inquiry form.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 (Runes)
- **Language**: TypeScript (strict mode)
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS 4
- **3D Visualization**: Three.js
- **Backend**: Firebase (Authentication & Firestore)
- **Deployment**: Vercel (Edge Network)
- **Internationalization**: Paraglide.js (Indonesian & English)

## Content Topics

- Svelte / SvelteKit development patterns
- AI and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) implementations
- Geospatial (GIS) web applications
- Frontend performance optimization
- TypeScript best practices
- Firebase integration patterns

## Languages

Available in Indonesian (id, default) and English (en). Language can be switched via URL prefix or locale selector.
